# 📢 NH Reader v0.7.1 — Android CI Patch & Verification Hardening

**Release Date:** 2026-10-01
**Tag:** [`v0.7.1`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.7.1)

---

## 🔧 What's in v0.7.1

v0.7.1 is a focused CI infrastructure patch with no user-facing app changes. If you're running v0.7.0 on desktop, everything you already have continues to work identically — this release exists to get Android APKs properly building and publishing in our release pipeline.

---

## 🤖 Android Packaging — Fixed

The v0.7.0 CI run broke the Android build job with a silent but fatal error:

```
error: invalid value 'aarch64,armv7,x86_64' for '--target [<TARGETS>...]'
```

`tauri android build --target` takes **repeated flags**, not a comma-separated list. Fixed to `--target aarch64 --target armv7 --target x86_64`.

The `on_window_event` closure was also emitting `unused_variables` warnings on Android targets where the `#[cfg(desktop)]` block compiles away. Prefixed with `_` to suppress without changing desktop behaviour.

Migrated `actions/setup-java@v4` → `@v5` to clear the deprecation warning.

---

## 🛡️ Manual Release Recovery Input

A new `release_tag` workflow dispatch input lets you manually re-attach assets to an existing release tag without pushing a new tag — useful if the publish step fails after a successful build.

---

## 📋 Verification Rules Hardened

Agent rules now explicitly require dry-run validation for CI workflow changes before pushing, and forbid pushing unverified code to remote.

---
